svg.title: L4 Class — chassis-native bodies vs subprocess-shim bodies

g.text: L4 Class — chassis-native bodies vs subprocess-shim bodies
Fractal substitution made tangible: two completely different internal implementations of the same external CLI contract.
🟢 NEW or chassis (created/lives in scrap, by this plan or earlier)
🔵 KEPT body — chassis-native, existed before this plan
🟠 WRAPPED — external script invoked by a shim
🟣 COMPOSER — bash orchestrator at the top
The composer doesn't care which internal shape each
sub-agent uses. It calls them all the same way:
subprocess → check exit code → read last-line JSON →
v2 fan-out: each subprocess call becomes a sibling
Paperclip role with its own parent/sub-issue. No
